propositions: A mixed-provider fallback chain resolves prompt_cache_style to 'none' by conservative intersection because cache keys are provider-specific and non-intersecting
An operator observing cache_read_tokens=0 and cache_write_tokens=0 for a chain-backed op may incorrectly conclude caching regressed when the same model called alone caches normally
docs/llm-framework.md's accounting section did not document that fallback chains disable prompt caching, leaving operators without explanation for zero cache counts
runner_support._intersect_capabilities implements the capability intersection logic that collapses disagreeing prompt_cache_style values to 'none' for fallback chains
Documentation must clarify the observable consequence that a chain reports 0/0 cache metrics while the single model reports normal cache behavior
